These fixtures are sanitized replays of verbatim orchestrator captures in `.scratch/live-fixtures2/README-findings.txt` and `.scratch/live-fixtures5/`. Values such as IDs, titles, paths, and free-text activity are redacted; payload keys and value types are preserved.

The real `run --json` response is one stdout JSON object and writes `Using workspace ...` to stderr. `run-permission.json` preserves the early `status: permission` response. `wait-permission.json` preserves the later wait response with `status: permission`; it triggers another permission check and wait. The real `send --json`, idle `wait --json`, stop, workspace-create/archive, inspect, pending-permit, deny, and stale-permit payloads are replayed here. `logs --json` is plain text despite its flag. `permit-ls.json`, `permit-pending.json`, and `permit-no-description.json` replay captured pending-row shapes; none carries structured command/path data. An empty or `-` description is no evidence: without cooperative trust it parks with the raw row retained, and with owned-agent trust it may be allowed only after the existing risky/outside checks. File-change permits carry no path, so this remains cooperative trust, not containment. The idle stop fixture and stale-permit error preserve the captured zero-stop and `NO_PENDING_PERMISSIONS` cases.
